focus_case: (1,1,8192,1024) BLOCK_SHARDED shard[1024,128] grid(8,8) bf16/HiFi2/fp32_acc_off/TILE/bf16 TILE gamma
plan: s=8 hidden slices, S=4 hidden tiles/core, B=8 block_rows, 4 blocks, 32 shard row-tiles/core, 64 cores = 8 row-groups x 8
coverage: 100 markers max of 250 cap; last user zone ends at 1.00 of KERNEL span on every RISC
ranked_bottleneck: the row-group ROOT serializes the whole group: 56 of 64 cores idle 84% of the wall in rd_bcast_recv waiting for the root; the root pays a 64-fp32-tile REDUCE per block (256 tiles = 1 MB of stat traffic per root core) plus a 1 MB incast

method: cumulative peel, payload stubbed, CB+semaphore+barrier scaffolding kept, one fresh-cache profiled run each
verdict: the combine (root reduce 42.0 us + incast 12.0 us) IS the excess; floor+local = 19578 ns is already BELOW the 25640 reference, so the target is reachable by fixing the combine alone

roofline_gate.incast: 1 MB of fp32 stat tiles into ONE core = 87 GB/s measured ~ single-core L1 write-port roofline -> no transfer-level lever, only fewer bytes or more destinations
roofline_gate.root_reduce: 256 fp32 stat tiles (1 MB) per root core; information content is 8192 fp32 (32 KB) = 32x over-shipped
roofline_gate.local_compute: ~768 KB of L1 traffic in 7.5 us ~ 100 GB/s ~ L1 roofline; at most one pass (~2.5 us) removable by fusion

domain: every s>1 with min(s,B)>1; carve-out min(s,B)==1 (measured regression -9%/-5%) which IS the flat root parameterized at num_owners=1
helper_bypass: none needed for the recommended option
side_benefit: gather landing CB s*B -> s*(B/min(s,B)) pages = 32 KB vs 1 MB, unlocking coarser block_rows and I4
trap: noc_semaphore_inc_multicast as the gather signal inverts the result on 2-D groups (s=32: 149716 vs 31073) - use per-owner unicast atomics

idea: I2 two-level tree combine on the row-group rect
domain: every rect and both line orientations with s*B>=16; carve-out s*B==8 (measured regression 0.93x/0.96x/0.88x)
helper_bypass: raw pairwise add_tiles(acc_to_dest) for level 1 - capability gap: ReduceWithinTile::Skip unreachable (static_assert at reduce_helpers_compute.inl:885-891 sits AFTER the AccumulateViaAdd early-return)
note: a tree on a 1-D line does NOT degenerate (1.124x at 8x1); DEST holds B tiles at level 1 so fp32_dest_acc_en=True needs chunking at DEST_AUTO_LIMIT=4

idea: I3 compact transposed 128 B stat gather
mechanism: halving payload bytes alone is a NULL, so the root cost is TILE COUNT its unpacker chews, not bytes in flight
domain: every s>=4; carve-out s<=3 (measured regression); s>32 works via ceil(s/32) landing tiles
helper_bypass: raw reduce+transpose_dest window - capability: no transpose helper in kernel_lib at all, and post_reduce_op cannot re-init MATH
must_ship_with: a cross-core SEM_LANDING_READY edge - the root zeroing un-owned landing lanes raced contributors writes and wiped landed partials (stat_pcc 0.048)

idea: I4 software-pipeline the block loop / fewer combine round trips
verdict: WIN (pipeline) + WIN-small (coarser stat) + NULL (decoupling stat from apply)

isolated_ns.coarse16_b8: 66043 (NULL vs base_b16 - decoupling buys nothing on a resident shard)

domain: every hidden-split plan with >1 combine round trip; flat (not excluded) at 1 round trip; BLOCKED by L1 beyond stat_rows=8 at s=8 (depth-2 landing needs 1410 KB vs a measured ~937 KB CB region)
note: the two levers are SUBSTITUTES not additive; the pipeline is strictly better; its L1 term is the s x SB fp32 landing buffer, which I1/I3 shrink

idea: I5 fuse scale+gamma into one DEST window (non-DEST_TO_SRCA mechanisms)
verdict: NULL for the idea as floated (every fusion mechanism REGRESSES) + WIN for what the investigation found instead
mechanism: this stage is MATH-thread-bound and the L1 crossings are FREE (PACK/UNPACK overlap MATH); two FPU ops/tile is the floor

win_found.option: interm_cb_bulk - replace the in-place pack + sync_pack_to_unpack with a one-block intermediate CB whose own push/wait IS the PACK->UNPACK edge
win_found.cost: BLOCK_TILES extra L1 pages (64 KB at focus)

bugs_found: ckl::DestReuseBinary returns WRONG DATA when block_size == DEST_AUTO_LIMIT (pcc 0.9866) - the parked GAMMA_FUSED path would be silently wrong on any S making DEST_BLOCK 8, incl. the perf-flagged (1,1,32,7168) at S=8; keep it off
sfpu_binary_bcast.h documents an fp32_dest_acc_en=True requirement that is not real (pcc 0.99999 at False)

knobs.DEST_BLOCK_TILES: 4 beats 8 by 4% at S=8/16 and is free at S=4/5
knobs.DEST_BLOCK_MIN_ROW_TILES=2 gate: costs ~2% at R=1, no measurable benefit
knobs.OUT_CB_DEPTH: irrelevant on TILE+sharded (cb_output_tiles IS the shard)

deferred_to_round_2: I2 tree combine (B==1, s*B>=16 regime only - I1 does not reach it)
I3 compact transposed stat gather (superseded by I1 at the focus geometry)
I4 pipeline the block loop (L1-gated; I1 freed some of the L1 it needs)

reasoning.I1_vs_I2_I3: all three attack the same stage; I1 is by far the largest (2.25x isolated vs 1.245x and 1.124x) and they are incompatible implementations, so the fastest NON-CONFLICTING choice is I1 alone. After I1 each owner gathers s*own_rows=16 tiles, which is exactly where I2 measured only 1.045-1.065x, so I1 also removes most of I2s remaining value in the B>1 regime.
reasoning.I5_declined: isolated WIN (0.976x at focus, 0.887x at decode-exact) that does NOT transfer: whole-op flat everywhere (sharded focus 34554->34301, prefill w1024 median 87231->87004 = -0.26% over 3 runs each) because the apply passes are not on the critical path, AND its B*S-page intermediate CB consumed the L1 that let I1s freed budget pick block_rows 16 instead of 8 (a -2.8% lever traded for a +2.4% one). Recorded, not forced in.

zone_overhead_note: the permanent zones cost ~0 in production (macro compiles out) but +17% on a 4 us kernel and +2% on a 73 us one WHEN PROFILING, so every perf claim here is zoned-vs-zoned; do not compare against Refinement 5s un-zoned numbers

focus_case: (1,1,8192,1024) BLOCK_SHARDED shard [1024,128] grid (8,8), bf16 / TILE / bf16 TILE gamma in DRAM / math_fidelity=HiFi2 / fp32_dest_acc_en=False; achievable_ns 25640; Blackhole p150b @1350 MHz (== the reference clock, no scaling needed)
geometry: s=8 hidden slices, S=4 hidden tiles/core, block_rows=16 -> num_blocks=2, num_owners=8, own_rows=2, 8 row-groups x 8 cores
zone_coverage: 84 markers max per (core,RISC) of the 250 cap; last user zone ends at 1.00 of the *-KERNEL span on every RISC
attribution_note: cb_wait_front in a compute kernel is UNPACK-only, so the hoisted wait zones only hoist on TRISC_0; math/pack absorb the wait inside the following work zone (cp_scale math 8327 / pack 11177 vs unpack 4242 is the absorbed 9284 ns cp_rms_wait, not payload). Rank off TRISC_0 + the ablation, never off math/pack zone values. On a resident output shard wr_store moves ZERO bytes, so wr_store_wait 20734 is pure occupancy (the mirror of compute latency), NOT a bottleneck.

ranked_bottleneck.3: fixed floor (boot/dispatch + 2 blocks of sync scaffolding + mcast round trips)

overlap_check: solo-minus-gather 10349 == cumulative 10294, so the gather is NOT overlap-hidden (it is a serial latency chain). solo-minus-local 13848 > cumulative 10517 because removing local also removes upstream serialization feeding the gather.
roofline_gate: gather moves 8 MB of fp32 stat tiles in 10.3 us = 815 GB/s aggregate (~15% of the 64-core NoC roofline) and 12.7 GB/s per receiving core (vs the 87 GB/s single-core L1 write-port roofline Perf 1 measured) -> the TRANSFER is far off its roofline, so the payload has real headroom. wr_gather_issue is 206 ns per 4 KB write = issue-side/transaction-count bound. The stat tile ships 4096 B whose information content after the within-tile collapse is 128 B -> a 32x over-ship.
L1_probe: widening l1_working_budget (the L1_SIZE_PER_CORE_FALLBACK knob, which IS live because device.l1_size_per_core is not bound to Python) 1.0 -> 1.2 MB coarsens block_rows and gives 34591 -> 32550 ns (-6%) on this case; 1.4 MB is flat (32676). R4 measured the SAME widening as a LOSS on the interleaved prefill (+5.7% / +3.7%), so this lever is regime-split and needs its domain measured, not assumed.

step: portfolio + per-idea verdicts (all measured in isolation, subagent benches)

P1_compact_stat_gather.verdict: WIN, NOT graduated (conflicts with P6 on the same landing machinery)
P1_compact_stat_gather.stage_ns: 25278 -> 19164 (1.319x) at the focus geometry; baseline is LINEAR in s (+1.2 us/slice) and the candidate is FLAT (22.5 -> 24.1 us from s=8 to s=32)
P1_compact_stat_gather.exception: measured-regression at s==2 (0.876x) - two contributors do not repay the contributor-side collapse+transpose; s==4 is FLAT (0.98-1.06x) and IN the domain
P1_compact_stat_gather.precision: out_pcc identical to baseline to 7 digits; collapse-then-sum == sum-then-collapse verified, not assumed
P1_compact_stat_gather.note: transaction-count ceiling measured at ~3% via a deliberately-wrong 64B probe, so fewer-transactions is NOT the lever here - fewer BYTES is

P2_gather_coalesce.why: swept transaction count 8x at fixed bytes: cost is ~13 ns/transaction on top of a ~3000 ns/block floor that is INDEPENDENT of transaction count. The breakdowns 206 ns-per-4KB-write is a division artifact - only 13 ns of it is per-transaction. The gather is BYTE/congestion-bound, not issue-bound.
P2_gather_coalesce.exception: measured-regression at s<=3 (0.914x), attributable to the combine datapath (forced AccumulateViaAdd below COMBINE_ACCUMULATE_MIN_TILES), not the paging

P3_gamma_first.verdict: WIN -> GRADUATE (but NOT by the proposed mechanism)
P3_gamma_first.mechanism: the FOLD into sum_of_squares is a REGRESSION (0.889x) - sum_of_squares packs nothing today, so folding gamma in ADDS a pack to pass 1 and delays the last Sum(x^2) partial, slipping the whole groups gather. What wins is the REORDER the fold implied: run apply_gamma BEFORE the combine (pre-combine side), so it executes inside the window compute already spent blocked in cp_rms_wait.
P3_gamma_first.exception: measured-regression at s==1 (-2.2%), ISOLATED to gammas DRAM arrival not the pattern: with gamma resident in L1 the same reorder is dead flat at s==1 (45612 -> 45550) while the focus win is unchanged. The op defers gammas read barrier because the combine hides it; at s==1 there is no combine to hide it behind.
P3_gamma_first.secondary: DEST_BLOCK_TILES 8->4 REFUTED - 8 is best at every S (S=8 and S=16 both lose a repeatable 1.2% at 4). Perf 1s round-2 queue item 4 is wrong; leave the knob at 8.

P4_finalize_sfpu_scope.split: the owner combine is 5535 ns of which the FINALIZE is 3993 (72%) and the reduce math only 1542 (28%) - the finalize IS the combine
P4_finalize_sfpu_scope.isolated_sfpu: 989.7 -> 240.1 ns per finalize (4.12x); 96 -> 8 SFPU vector ops; scope is the lever (3.49x alone), fusion only 1.10x alone
P4_finalize_sfpu_scope.domain: EVERYWHERE - no exceptions. Correct on 18 cells: BLOCK/WIDTH/HEIGHT/INTERLEAVED, TILE and ROW_MAJOR, bf16/float32/bfloat8_b, fp32_dest_acc_en both, HiFi2 and HiFi4, W- and H-non-aligned, gamma and no-gamma, block_rows 1..16, both call sites
P4_finalize_sfpu_scope.precision: bit-identical on column 0; the skipped lanes are provably never read (BroadcastDim::Col consumer AND the funnel noc write); APPROX never flipped
P4_finalize_sfpu_scope.bonus: the post_reduce_op re-init hazard was tested directly at BLOCK_ROWS=16 and does NOT bite for SFPU inits - no live bug

P5_block_count_budget.finding: device.l1_size_per_core is NOT bound in Python, so the 1 MB L1_SIZE_PER_CORE_FALLBACK is what actually runs while the allocator reports 1,461,376 B/bank - the ladder has been leaving 430 KB unused
carve_outs: measured-regression ROW_MAJOR sharded: U-shaped with minimum at the shipped B=8; coarsening costs 4.1% (B16) / 5.6% (B32) because the core tilizes its own sticks into a B*S-tile CB before the reduce starts - a longer serial fill

measured-regression the INTERLEAVED partition SEARCH: +5.7% on (1,1,8192,5120). Refinement 4s attribution was WRONG - block_rows is 1 in BOTH plans; what moves is the searchs admission filter, which a wider budget lets pick G=110,s=1,S=160,depth1 over G=55,s=2,S=80,depth2
P5_block_count_budget.resilience: 29 sharded resilience cells x 3 budgets: outcome set IDENTICAL; the pre-existing 13x777x1023 WIDTH failure is untouched (its per-core shard is 1.33 MB, beyond any of these budgets)

P6_block_pipeline.verdict: WIN -> GRADUATE (largest single win; supersedes P5 as a lever but NEEDS P5s budget fix to be affordable)
P6_block_pipeline.head_to_head_vs_P5: pipelined B=16/nb=2 = 28282 ns @ 476 KB CB BEATS fat B=32/nb=1 = 32765 ns @ 540 KB CB -> 1.16x faster with 64 KB LESS L1. Hiding a round trip beats deleting one.
P6_block_pipeline.sweep: win grows with round trips: nb=2 1.223x, nb=4 1.128x (lead 2), nb=8 1.310x, nb=16 1.349x; (1,1,8192,2048) 1.301x where P5s fat block is L1-INFEASIBLE
P6_block_pipeline.precision: bit-identical to the serial baseline, not merely PCC-equal
P6_block_pipeline.domain: everywhere with a cross-core combine and num_blocks>1. num_blocks==1 and s==1 clamp the leads to 0 and emit a BYTE-IDENTICAL program (flat, IN the domain). INTERLEAVED/ROW_MAJOR are inexpressible AS IMPLEMENTED (unimplemented extension, not a correctness bar). measured-regression: NONE anywhere.
P6_block_pipeline.raw_llk: none - uses ckl::reduce, eltwise_chain and mcast_pipe exactly as shipped
bugs_found: the cumulative gather counter is NOT pipeline-safe: one counter waited as (block+1)*s lets a run-ahead contributor satisfy it with half the contributors missing -> a SILENT wrong answer (PCC 0.99994 -> 0.99912, no hang). Fixed with one counter per landing window.
the op DESTROYS its own input on the resident-shard path (scale rewrites x in place in the callers buffer), so any A/B harness that uploads x once feeds variant N+1 an already-normalized tensor

aggregation: P6 and P1 both rewrite the gather landing machinery and cannot both graduate this round; P6 wins the overlap on a MEASURED whole-op number (28282) vs P1s estimate, with no raw LLK and no measured regression. P5 is not superseded by P6 - it is P6s PREREQUISITE (the ladder must be able to afford the leads). P2 discarded (null). Graduating: P6 + P4 + P3 + P5.
